description: Sixteen sliders held in twenty-four banks, each slider sent to its own output and to a polyphonic output

params.text: Selects that bank, so the sliders show and put out the values stored in it; with COPY, CLEAR or RNDM armed, pressing a bank copies into it, empties it or fills it with random values
Arms copying, so the next bank pressed receives a copy of the bank showing; pressing it again returns to plain bank selection
Arms clearing, so the next bank pressed is emptied; pressing it again returns to plain bank selection
Arms randomising, so the next bank pressed is filled with random slider values; pressing it again returns to plain bank selection
Steps back one bank, wrapping round to the last one
Steps forward one bank, wrapping round to the first one

inputs.text: Picks the bank directly, 0-10V across the twenty-four, and while a cable is patched here the bank buttons are overridden
A rising edge steps forward one bank
A rising edge steps back one bank
A rising edge returns to the first bank
A polyphonic input added to the sliders, channel by channel, before they reach the outputs

outputs.text: The value of that slider in the bank showing, in the voltage range chosen for it, plus anything on that channel of the poly add input
All sixteen slider values on one polyphonic cable, in the same order as the individual outputs

notes: drag a slider to set its value; a slider carries no label until one is typed into the Labels submenu of the right-click menu
menu: Slider #1 through Slider #16 — each holds an Output Range submenu setting the span that slider covers, from -10.0 to 10.0 down to 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 to 10.0 to start with
Match Cable Colors — draws each slider in the colour of the cable patched to its output
Visualize Summed Voltages — draws what the polyphonic add input adds to each slider
Labels — opens sixteen text fields, one per slider, for a name of your own
